compaction_wall_share.instrumentation_cross_check_note: The stdout ticks' cumulative 'elapsed' at the 100,000,000-op checkpoint is 27586.7s; wall_s (DONE line, matches build-record.json) is 28372.936s -- a gap of only 786.236s. But build-record.json's authoritative finalisation_phases sum to 3405.467s (compact 571.91 + digest 2759.624 + gc 38.848 + stats 35.085), which does not reconcile with the 786.236s tick-based gap (short by ~2619.2s). Not root-caused here (possibly the tick print lags under heavy finalization I/O, or the finalisation timers overlap the last ingest tick's window) -- flagged for the coordinator, not resolved. The authoritative finalisation_phases and the overall wall_s (both from build-record.json / the DONE line) are used for scoring; the tick-based gap is reported only as a cross-check that did not close.
compaction_wall_share.method: build_synth_store.py's checkpoint log has no native per-compaction timer for the 100 in-loop compactions; their combined cost is estimated from checkpoint-delta pairs within each 1,000,000-op cycle (second 500k-op half minus first 500k-op half, same-cycle steady-rate assumption). The FINAL (101st) compaction, streaming digest, gc, and stats phases are separately and authoritatively timed in build-record.json's build_info.finalisation_phases.

build_info.ops_per_s_by_decile_source: derived from build-100m.stdout.log progress ticks -- build-record.json's own field was null for this run, unlike the 10M/30M records
build_info.rss_series_source: external sampler (/proc/<pid>/status VmHWM every 30s) independent of the harness's own periodic maxrss figure -- same convention as Stage 0/30M

host_controls.commit_stamp_mechanism: Stage 0's .HEAD_COMMIT + TGMS_COMMIT (git absent on iTiger compute nodes); RUN_STARTED/ABORT guard verified against b159bd10aa53ad5de5f4e8ff7af1c87789d6afd0

build_vmhwm_h1_h2.trajectory: ingest plateau climbed ~linearly from ~0.4GB (500K ops) to ~127.75GB (100,000,000-op checkpoint) -> final compaction -> 167.27GB -> streaming digest -> 186.42GB peak
build_vmhwm_h1_h2.unit_note: 'GB' here = vmhwm_kb / 1,000,000, the same convention the campaign's Stage-0/30M records use (verified against the Stage-0 10M anchor: vmhwm_kb=19,897,476 -> 19.9 'GB', matching Addendum 5's own '19.9GB' prose) -- NOT true decimal GB (19,897,476 KiB is actually 20.87 true GB / 18.98 GiB). Using the campaign's own convention resolves this run's H1/H2 call unambiguously in-band; true GiB (177.79) would sit just under the 180 lower bound -- flagged here so the unit choice is auditable, not silent.
build_vmhwm_h1_h2.verdict: H2 (linear) confirmed again at 100M (in the 180-200GB band); H1 refuted

build_wall.note: Coordinator's own pre-written expectation (Addendum 6, before this run): 'the wall band will be exceeded because the 30M decay extrapolates to ~100 compactions averaging minutes each (~8-10h total)'. Measured 7.882h sits inside that stated expectation, i.e. the exceedance was anticipated, not a surprise.

query_ready_floor.description: Addendum 5/6 Stage 1 100M row 'query-ready floor': a FRESH process cold-opens the finished store (read_only=True) and runs the 13-operator registry once each; VmHWM of that process.
query_ready_floor.note: Ran once, cleanly, via --dependency=afterany:213188 with nothing else touching the store -- no writer-lock race like the 30M lane's first attempt (query_floor.py's read_only=True fix, landed by the 30M lane, was already in place for this run).

recovery_ce5000.verdict: MISS-not-refuted (6.310h exceeds the 6h upper bound by 1.052x, but falsifier is >2x upper (12.0h) -- not tripped); digest_equal=True

scale_curve.note: 6/13 operators executed, 7/13 refused by the cost guardrail. Of the 6 executed, hist.single/hist.asof REFUTED their bars by ~30x (12.97/13.00ms vs 2.40/2.05ms bars); paths.k/series.count/burst.zscore/motif.filtered PASS. Only reach.window's refusal was anticipated by Addendum 5; the other six refusals (snap.hop2, diff.global, nbr.evolution, coactive.narrow, resolve.substr, agg.rel_bucket) are a new finding -- see scale-curve-100m.json for the full per-operator table.

steady_decile_ops_per_s.verdict: TRIPPED (< 10,000) -- compaction cost per decile window grows with rows compacted (D-164), throughput decays monotonically through the whole build, more steeply than the 30M run (30M median 8,463.0; 100M median 3738.9)

version_history.verdict: wall PASS (18.982s, well under the <=60s band); VmHWM 12.817 GB exceeds the <=10GB point prediction but is well under the documented ~25GB falsifier line -- scored MISS-not-refuted (prediction exceeded, falsifier not tripped), not REFUTED
